briefdescription.para: Adds a new tab with a fresh Panes container.
Removes the currently active tab and its Panes.
Returns the active tab's Panes via getTabContentComponent.
TabbedComponent with ValueTree state and per-tab Panes.

detaileddescription.para: Inherits jam::TabbedComponent for tab strip and content management. Each tab's content component is an end::Panes instance, owned by TabbedComponent (deleteComponentWhenNotNeeded = true).
